categories.main_business_segments: Imeik Technology Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the medical instruments and devices manufacturing industry, focusing on Class III medical devices used in medical aesthetics. The company develops, produces, and sells biomedicine materials and biopharmaceutical products, including skin injection fillers, facial implant lines, and related medical devices. It also engages in research and development of recombinant proteins and peptides for medical applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as multi-component composite hydrogel, solid-state gradient interpenetrating crosslinking, water-tight microsphere suspension preparation, tissue fluid bionic technology, and precise water cutting technology. It strictly adheres to ISO13485 and GMP standards for medical device quality management and has established a comprehensive quality management system. Production is planned based on market demand and sales forecasts, maintaining reasonable inventory levels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Imeik serves medical aesthetic institutions including public hospitals' plastic surgery and dermatology departments, as well as private medical aesthetic clinics. Its products target end consumers seeking non-surgical and surgical aesthetic treatments, with a focus on skin filling, wrinkle correction, and tissue repair. The company also collaborates with medical professionals and institutions for product training and academic promotion.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in East China, North China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, Northeast China, and Northwest China regions. It has subsidiaries and operations in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and other major cities, as well as a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong. Overseas sales are minimal but the company is exploring international expansion opportunities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Imeik operates in the midstream segment of the medical aesthetics supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and product development of medical devices and biomedicine materials. It sources raw materials from upstream suppliers and sells finished products to downstream medical service providers. The company manages procurement, production, warehousing, and logistics to ensure product quality and timely delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in biomedicine materials and medical aesthetics products, investing over 10% of revenue in R&D. It focuses on expanding product indications, developing new injectable fillers, recombinant proteins, and peptides, and enhancing digital marketing and academic brand building. Strategic initiatives include clinical trials, regulatory approvals, and collaboration with academic institutions to drive technology commercialization and product pipeline expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Imeik generates revenue primarily through direct sales and distribution of its self-developed and manufactured medical aesthetic products. The sales model combines direct sales to medical institutions with supplementary distribution channels. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of product control to customers, mainly through product sales contracts. The company also derives income from investment returns and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Imeik is a leading domestic player in China's medical aesthetic product manufacturing sector, holding the top market share among Chinese companies in hyaluronic acid-based skin fillers since 2018. It competes with other medical device manufacturers in the high-barrier, highly regulated Class III medical device market. The company emphasizes brand reputation, product innovation, and regulatory compliance to maintain its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Imeik reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.03 billion, a 5.45% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.96 billion, up 5.33%. Total assets reached RMB 8.34 billion, growing 21.72% from the prior year. The company maintains strong profitability with a return on equity of 28.01% and continues to invest heavily in R&D to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Imeik offers high-quality, innovative medical aesthetic products with proven safety and efficacy, including the first domestically commercialized long-lasting and lidocaine-containing skin fillers. Its comprehensive product portfolio addresses diverse clinical needs, supported by strong R&D capabilities and regulatory approvals. The company enhances customer value through academic support, digital marketing, and a robust supply chain ensuring product traceability and reliability.
